source:
@@U02403@@
Boasting becomes you;
but now let’s see some of your arts.

@@U02405@@
Watch! I snap my fingers
and already the chariot glitters brightly!
Look!
A string of pearls leaps out!

@@U02406@@
(He continues snapping his fingers all about.)

@@U02407@@
You see?
Golden clasps for neck or ear!
Combs, coronets, rings set with priceless jewels!
Now and again I dispense a spark of flame,
hoping to see it catch somewhere.

@@U02409@@
Look at them!
Snatching and grabbing for treasure!
The poor boy’s nearly in danger of them!
The way he throws gems,
you'd think it was a dream,
and everyone in the whole hall snatching!
Ah, but here come new tricks!
No matter what one seizes,
it’s a pale reward:
it flutters off and he’s
empty-handed.
Strings of pearls
dissolve into so many beetles;
they throw them off and they
buzz around their heads,
the poor dunces!
Others, instead of a solid handful,
find all they've grasped is
frivolous butterflies.
translation:
@@U02403@@
夸口就成了你；
但现在让我们来看看你的一些艺术作品。

@@U02405@@
观看！我打响指
战车已经闪闪发光了！
看！
一串珍珠跃出！

@@U02406@@
（他继续打响指。）

@@U02407@@
你看到了吗？
颈部或耳朵的金色扣环！
梳子、皇冠、戒指都镶嵌着无价的珠宝！
我时不时地喷出火花，
希望看到它在某个地方捕获。

@@U02409@@
看看他们！
抢夺宝藏！
这个可怜的男孩几乎面临着他们的危险！
他扔宝石的方式，
你会以为那是一场梦
和整个大厅的人抢！
啊，但是新花样来了！
无论抓住什么，
这是一个苍白的奖励：
它飘走了，他在
两手空空。
珍珠串
化为许多甲虫；
他们把它们扔掉，然后他们
他们的头顶嗡嗡作响，
可怜的笨蛋！
其他人，而不是少数，
发现他们所掌握的只是
轻浮的蝴蝶。
